name: John I
note: born c. 1279; ruled with his brother Frederick IV

name: Frederick IV
note: co-ruler with John I, sole rule after his death

name: John III
note: also Margrave of Brandenburg-Kulmbach from 1398; co-ruler with Frederick VI

name: Frederick VI
note: co-ruler with John III; also Margrave of Brandenburg-Ansbach, Elector of Brandenburg from 1415; in 1427 sold Nuremberg Castle and his burgrave rights to the Imperial City (House of Hohenzollern page); title ends
